description: See inside any Cashu token, offline. Decode, encode and inspect Cashu tokens (NUT-00) and payment requests (NUT-18), including NUT-10/11/14 spending conditions. Zero dependencies, zero network calls.
name: nut-inspect

scripts.demo: node -e "import('node:http').then(async http=>{const fs=await import('node:fs');const path=await import('node:path');const types={'.html':'text/html','.js':'text/javascript'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{let p=req.url==='/'?'/demo/index.html':req.url;fs.readFile(path.join(process.cwd(),p),(e,d)=>{if(e){res.writeHead(404);res.end('not found')}else{res.writeHead(200,{'content-type':types[path.extname(p)]||'text/plain'});res.end(d)}})}).listen(3737,()=>console.log('demo: http://localhost:3737'))})"
